name: Post Matric Scholarship to the Girls Belonging to Other Backward Classes taking admission in Professional Courses
name_key: post matric scholarship to girls belonging to other backward classes taking admission in professional courses
provider: OBC, SEBC, VJNT & SBC Welfare Department
benefit: Eligible OBC girl applicants are provided the following maintenance allowance: / Group A | RS.425 | RS.190 / Group B | RS.290 | RS.190 / Group C | RS.290 | RS.190
course: Applicant must be pursuing a professional course approved by the government.
academic_requirement: Minimum 75% attendance is mandatory for the current academic year.
income_criteria: The annual family income should be less than or equal to RS.2.5 lakh.
domicile_criteria: Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra.
eligibility_text: The annual family income should be less than or equal to RS.2.5 lakh. Applicant must belong to the OBC category. Applicant must be a resident of Maharashtra. Applicant must be pursuing a professional course approved by the government. If the applicant fails in any academic year, she will receive benefits only for that year, but not for the subsequent year until she is promoted to the next class.
